_comment: Diagnostic: the deep pilot (box_exponent 1/2) shows a straight log-log on 256..8192 at slope -1.0453 vs 1 - 187/91 = -1.0549. models/percolation_tau.py documents a cutoff drift s**(1 - d_f*box_exponent) = s**(5/96) at 1/2; 0.6 > 1/d_f makes the cutoff recede (s**-0.14) without importing d_f. If the bias shrinks here, the 25 coverage failure is the box rule, not the estimator.
